summary: Restore the missing reflexive pronoun in bedankte sich
rationale: German sich bedanken requires the reflexive pronoun. The supplied edition translation at 36/107 has und bedankte sich beim Sultan.

summary: Valency: l-marked overt senders occur with Preterit agent suffixes (32/33, 39/29, 69/405); l-marked recipients occur too (96/282). Establish the role from verb agreement and clause context, not l- alone. Stacked recipient and theme suffixes occur at 57/205, 78/140 and 115/285.
The bəṯr- summons is attested across Preterit and Infectum and several texts. Sending soldiers or servants after someone with an overt theme (69/373, 73/133) remains sense 1.
Message themes xabro/maktub and omitted messengers are ordinary sending, not automatically new idioms. No lexicalized light-verb construction is established by these verses.

Aspect: Mšadárwalle (MAC Murder/48) adds Preterit-wa. The ko-Preterit analysis of kəmšadalle at 65/465 is supported by the agent suffix but needs segmentation checked. Edition tense choices are not grounds for changing the Turoyo box.
Retain šaderu as an Imperativ variant within II and the attested suffix assimilation spellings. No new stem is established.
Sixteen compact occurrence records provide no verse; their routine analyses remain provisional, with no quotations added.
All six Jan tokens are II.1 schicken. None has a bəṯr-summoning frame, so no additional support is claimed for round-1 sense 2.
mšadriwo provides the Infectum-wa box not supplied in round 1; it is distinct from the round-1 Preterit-wa Mšadárwalle.

Divine and human agents, a helper/ordainer, letters and a book share the sending relation. Feminine -la agrees with i ruḥo qadišto; -lox marks the recipient. No new lexical meaning follows from the religious register.
The postal b-phrase marks channel and l-bayto destination. They do not establish an idiomatic phrase. Preterit thin-cell claims refer to the original glossary and are superseded by round-1 additions.

The inherited example šdr.II.d.infinitiv.1 (107/23) has agentive šedartayḏux 'your sending' followed by active mšadallax bəṯri. Should this Infinitiv be moved out of Detransitive? No structural correction is applied without resolving the glossary's classification.

Confirm ko-Preterit segmentation at 65/465 against reduced Infectum plus theme suffix; confirm mšadrile at 70/91 and contracted mšadrallux at 107/31. The latter remains uncertain without using the German tense as proof.
At MAC NI Three kinds of death/12, should predicative u+mšadro be retained with Part. Pass. or treated exclusively as a lexical noun?
No German edition translation is supplied at 69/177; the bracketed supplementary English is not quoted. Alignment is flagged at 105/31, so that translation is not quoted.
Check nošo with mšadarralli (82/63), -lan versus German mich (78/196), and the 1sg.f ending of mšadralle (107/30).
Supply verse text for the sixteen compact routine records before treating their analyses as independently verified.

All quoted Jan English is the supplied project machine translation; confirm the new Infectum-wa translation during editorial review. No additional unresolved lexical proposal arises from these six tokens.
Inanimate and abstract themes include food, gifts, letters, insults and an allotted share; retain schicken rather than split themes into senses.
u+mšadro d Alóho is predicative and substantivized, God’s sent one; evidence does not independently establish a separate lexical verb sense messenger.

evidence.cite: MAC NI Three kinds of death/12
